# M07 specification — the real reference journey (W25) and the v0.2 gate

**Status:** design-lane authority for package M07 (plan v1.2 §4.4 row M07; gates **W25**, owned, and the 0.2.0
release gate over V11–V20 and W21–W27). Written 2026-10-16 on `wp/M07` (after `origin/main` @ `da781c8`).
**Decisions:** ADR 0041 (journey and W25), ADR 0042 (0.2.0 release policy, Proposed), register R-331…R-339.
**Reference values:** `benchmarks/m07/registration.json`, generated by `docs/derivations/scripts/m07_reference.py`
(standard library only; `--check` regenerates in memory and compares bytes). Every `M07.Ann` id below is cited by that
generator (GC-CAT-2) and by the evidence manifest.

## 0. The answer, in one paragraph

The journey takes **one decision**, the reactor-inlet temperature T_in of `C1-LOOP-M02-v1` (SPEC-S3-T, box
[653.15, 693.15] K, objective `c1-obj-nh3-liquid-v1` = liquid NH₃ product, purge 0.02), through four rungs of reactor
fidelity: **R0** the synthetic stand-in (fixed per-pass conversion, no temperature rise) on a nine-point grid;
**R1** the PyMRM reactor v3 (M02) on the same grid; **R2** the M04 surrogate, which is **not promotable** (M04's real
outcome, R-364), so R2 records that verdict and evaluates nothing; **R3** M05's trust-region study on the parent
(stage A skipped, `surrogate_not_promoted`). Each adjacent pair of decisions is compared by the **parent's** objective
at both decisions against the parent's noise floors (fidelity-effect class FE), the refined decision is checked against
the parent grid (truth check TC-1), and every decision carries its bound activity, constraints, uncertainty and compute
cost. W25 is **met** when the journey's record and report state all of that, honestly, reproducibly — whatever the
decision turns out to be. Budget exhausted, surrogate not promotable, an indifferent rung and a bound-active decision
are outcomes, not failures. The 0.2.0 gate is a second registry entry `v0.2-gate-v1` in `scripts/v0_2_gate.py` that
claims all seventeen gates and is judged at its own candidate.

  constraints, discrepancy and compute cost. Insufficient evidence or exhausted refinement budget remains a valid honest
  outcome"); plan v1.2 §4.4 (M07 row, W21–W27), §5.1 (BLOCKED never passes). Consistent with: ADR 0022 (C1, zero ΔP),
  R-152 (K_NH₃), ADR 0027/0033–0035 (reactor boundary and execution), ADR 0036/0037 (M04), ADRs 0038/0039 and M05
  design note §7, §11, §16–§18 (R-296…R-300, R-313…R-318, R-326…R-330; REAL box R-330), ADR 0028 and the alpha spec
  `docs/derivations/V02-alpha-release-spec.md` (on `wp/V02-alpha-gate`, Amendments 1–4), M06 W27 registration
  (`docs/derivations/M06-W27-registration.md`, Amendments 1–3). No frozen interface (plan §2.1) or schema (§2.2) changes.
- **In scope.** The journey's rungs, rules, budget and record; W25's clauses; the report; `v0.2-gate-v1`; the 0.2.0 RC

- **Out of scope.** Re-deciding anything §1 cites; M05's study design; M04's verdict; W27's scoring; running the

## 2. What this specification establishes

1. The journey's case, decision, rungs, grid, decision rules, budget and stop rule (§4), as executable reference
   functions with registered fixtures whose boundaries are exact in binary64 (§12).
2. W25's eight clauses and what passes and fails each (§5).
3. The journey record and report, their reproducibility class and the carry rule (§6).
4. The 0.2.0 claim set and gate set, the W23–W27 clause labels, and the RC steps 13–18 (§7, §8).
5. W27's place in the RC and its carry rule (§9); the release-note phrases (§10).
6. Numbered assertions with expectations and tolerances (§11); work orders (§13); open questions and Needs Frank
   (§14, §15). What it does **not** establish is §16.

## 3. Facts this rests on (each re-read by the generator where it is a number)

- **F1 — M04's real outcome.** `b2-it1` on v3 is `NOT_PROMOTABLE`, reason `band_not_finite` (26 of 632 certificate
  refusals); no amendment; iterations 2–3 inadmissible (R-364, M04 spec §20 Amendment 3, `docs/reviews/M04-review.md`,
  `benchmarks/m04/wo11-b2-it1-v3/`). M04 N6: M04 is `tested` whatever the real verdict; M05 uses the parent.
- **F2 — R0 is exactly indifferent in T_in.** The stand-in (`src/openflowsheet/models/c1/reactor_standin.py`) has
  ξ = 0.25 n_N₂,in per tube and T_out = T_in; the flash is a TP flash at 253.15 K and 10⁷ Pa. Every flow downstream
  of the heater is therefore independent of SPEC-S3-T in exact arithmetic, and so is J. *Measured* (previous specifier,
  `wp/M07` @ `e35b16d`, nine grid points): J = 0.46705958492513017 mol/s, (max − min)/max = 1.19 × 10⁻¹⁶. The value is
  a **regression fixture**; the indifference is the closed-form expectation. Bound: J ≤ 2 n_N₂,makeup = 0.4975 mol/s
  (steady-state N balance; makeup N₂ 0.24875 mol/s).
- **F3 — the real loop's measured cost** (M02 G12, `benchmarks/m02/g12-real-loop-v3*.json`): VERIFIED at 653.15,
  673.15 and 693.15 K with 4 reactor experiments each; solve wall 361.5 s, 165.2 s, 95.8 s; live re-run at 673.15 K
  bitwise. Reactor-inlet total flow increases with T_in at the three states (GC-G12-2) — a fact, not an expectation of
  the decision.
- **F4 — M05 without a surrogate** (M05 §7.6): stage A is skipped (`surrogate_not_promoted`); stage C runs with the
  constant basis; nothing else changes. M05 claims neither W25 nor global optimality (§11).
- **F5 — no equilibrium reactor exists** in the repository (no unit, no derivation). The dossier's §9 contrast
  (equilibrium favours ever-lower T, kinetics an interior optimum) is therefore **not** a rung here (§15 N3).

## 4. The journey

### 4.1 Case, decision, objective

| Item | Value | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Case | `C1-LOOP-M02-v1`: `benchmarks/m02/c1-loop-real.json` (R1, R3) and its twin `c1-loop-standin.json` (R0); the twins differ only in the reactor's model pin (GC-LOOP-2) | M02 §8.1, R-306 |
| Decision | SPEC-S3-T (preheater outlet = reactor inlet T), box [653.15, 693.15] K; nominal u₀ = 673.15 K | R-313, R-315, R-330 |
| Fixed | purge fraction 0.02; makeup and flash specifications as in the case file; P, H₂/N₂, inerts, per-tube flow are outcomes checked against v3's hard domain (M05 §7.1 constraints) | ADR 0039 |
| Objective | `c1-obj-nh3-liquid-v1`: NH₃ molar flow of the flash liquid, mol/s, maximized | M05 §7.1 |
| Decision tolerance | δ_T = 0.5 K | M05 N-F2 |
| Parent | `c1.reactor` variant `pymrm-6089593-g2-nz800-s123-v3`, sha256 `8b92540a…` (registration `variants.real`) | M02 |

### 4.2 Rungs

| Rung | Model | What runs | Decision it yields |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R0 | `c1.reactor_standin` `standin-x025-v1` (synthetic) | coupled loop solve at each of the nine grid points, in process | rung decision §4.4.1 |
| R1 | `c1.reactor` v3 (parent) | coupled loop solve at each grid point; noise floor e_k at each (§4.4.2) | rung decision §4.4.1 and the indifference set §4.4.2 |
| R2 | `c1.reactor_surrogate` (M04) | **if** M04's recorded verdict for the bound parent is `PROMOTABLE`: surrogate-backed loop solve at each grid point; otherwise nothing | `SURROGATE_NOT_PROMOTABLE` (today, F1), or a rung decision with the surrogate's discrepancy |
| R3 | parent, through M05 `c1-trf-study-v1` REAL | M05's study (S0 → [A skipped] → C → B, K_max = 3) | M05's best checked candidate T*, its candidate and study status |

R2 never contributes a decision that is compared by FE (§4.4.3): a surrogate decision is only a proposal for the
parent (M04 spec §7.4). When R2 runs, its grid decision is evaluated by the parent at the same grid point (R1 has it).

### 4.3 The grid

Nine decimal literals 653.15 + 5k K, k = 0…8: 653.15, 658.15, …, 693.15. The nominal 673.15 K is k = 4. The end points
are the box bounds (bound activity `BOUND_LOWER`, `BOUND_UPPER`); the seven inner points are `INTERIOR` (GC-GRID-5).
Each grid point edits SPEC-S3-T of the case file in memory to the binary64 value of its literal, canonicalizes, and
solves through `run_revision_session` (the route the document selects, `revision_coupled`) without committing — the
same procedure as M05's P1 (§7.4 there). *Why nine:* 5 K spacing is ten times δ_T, cheap enough for R1 (§4.5), and
puts the nominal and both bounds on the grid so the R0→R1 pair compares parent values at grid points only.

### 4.4 Rules (implemented in `m07_reference.py`; the build lane's `scripts/m07_journey.py` implements them again)

All J are in mol/s. "Verified" means outcome `CONVERGED` and certificate `VERIFIED` (M05 P1).

**4.4.1 Rung decision.** Over a rung's grid points:
- `INCOMPLETE` if any grid point is not verified; decision = the best verified point, or none if none is verified.
- otherwise `INDIFFERENT` if max J − min J ≤ 10⁻¹² · max |J|; decision = u₀ = 673.15 K (the simple model gives no
  reason to move);
- otherwise `DECIDED`; decision = the grid point with the largest J, an exact tie going to the lowest T.

*Tolerance 10⁻¹²:* R0's measured spread is 1.19 × 10⁻¹⁶ (F2), so the tolerance sits 8 × 10³ above the floor
(GC-R0-1 requires ≥ 10³); fixture r-02 tilts J by 8 × 10⁻¹¹ end to end and must read `DECIDED` (GC-RUNG-3 requires the
tilt ≥ 10 × the tolerance). It is a rung-level statement of structural flatness, not a resolution statement; resolution
is §4.4.2.

**4.4.2 Noise floor and indifference set.** For each R1 grid point k, e_k is M05's noise floor (M05 §7.4):
e_k = 2(|∂J/∂X̂|·ΔX_k + |∂J/∂ΔT̂|·ΔT_k), achieved coupling residuals from the run's `EXT-COUPLING` checks, inner-solve
central differences h_X = 10⁻⁴, h_T = 10⁻² K (four inner solves, no reactor call). The build lane calls M05's
implementation of that formula; it does not re-implement it. The **indifference set** is the ascending list of verified
grid T_k with J_k ≥ J_best − (e_k + e_best). It is R1's uncertainty statement: "on the grid, the parent cannot tell
these temperatures apart".

**4.4.3 Before/after pairs.** Two pairs are compared: **P01** = (R0 decision → R1 decision) and **P13** = (R1 decision →
R3 candidate T*). For each, j_before and j_after are **parent** values at t_before and t_after with their noise floors:
for P01 both are R1 grid points (673.15 K is on the grid); for P13 j_after = J* and e* from M05's P1 targeted check and
noise floor at T*. A pair whose t_after does not exist (R1 has no verified point; R3 has no candidate) has
t_after = null.

**4.4.4 Fidelity-effect class**, with ε = e_before + e_after and Δj = j_after − j_before, in this precedence:
1. `FE_NOT_DETERMINED` if t_after is null;
2. `FE_WORSE` if Δj < −ε;
3. `FE_UNCHANGED` if |t_after − t_before| ≤ δ_T;
4. `FE_CHANGED` if Δj > ε;
5. `FE_WITHIN_RESOLUTION` otherwise (the decision moved, the parent cannot tell the gain from its noise).

Boundaries are inclusive as written (fixtures fe-02, fe-04, fe-06, fe-08 sit exactly on them). `FE_CHANGED` is the
blueprint's "measured effect of fidelity on the decision"; the others are its honest absence.

**4.4.5 Truth check TC-1** (the refined decision against the parent grid): with B the best verified R1 grid point,
`TC1_HOLDS` iff J* ≥ J_B − (e* + e_B); else `TC1_CONTRADICTED`. `TC1_NO_GRID` if R1 has no verified point;
`TC1_NOT_APPLICABLE` if R3 has no candidate. The record carries B's T.

**4.4.6 Bound activity.** `BOUND_LOWER` if |T − 653.15|/20 ≤ 10⁻⁶, `BOUND_UPPER` if |T − 693.15|/20 ≤ 10⁻⁶, else
`INTERIOR` (M05 §7.4's 10⁻⁶ scaled; half-width 20 K, so 2 × 10⁻⁵ K). A bound-active decision carries the bound phrase
(§6.3) verbatim.

**4.4.7 The journey's decision.** R3's T* if R3's candidate status is `PARENT_LOCAL_EVIDENCE` and TC-1 holds; otherwise
the best verified R1 grid point, labelled `grid_only` with the reason (R3's status, or `TC1_CONTRADICTED`); otherwise
none (`INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`). The journey never reports a decision from R0 or R2.

### 4.5 Budget `M07-budget-v1` and stop rule

| Rung | Cold reactor experiments | Wall | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R0 | 0 | 600 s | in process |
| R1 | 60 | 5400 s | ≥ 1.5 × (9 points × F3's worst 4 experiments, 361.5 s): 54 and 4880 s (GC-COST-1) |
| R2 | 0 (surrogate only; its grid parent values are R1's) | 1200 s | |
| R3 | 400 | 14400 s | M05-budget-v1 REAL (N-F3); M05 enforces it |
| Journey | 460 | 21600 s (6 h) | GC-BUDGET-1 |

Each rung checks its budget **before** each evaluation; a rung that would exceed it stops with `BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`,
records what it has, and the journey continues with the next rung on the evidence it has (blueprint §14.4). Store hits
cost no experiment. A real evaluation runs 25–45 s, up to 150 s under load; the budget is generous by design, and
exhausting it is a result to report, not to retry.

### 4.6 Execution, carry, and refusal

- **One script, no new operation.** `scripts/m07_journey.py {run,check,replay,render}` composes existing application
  calls (`run_revision_session`, the experiment store, M05's study entry point). **No job operation is added** (M05
  N-F7 deferred it to M07; DECISION in R-336): an operation would extend a frozen interface for one script's benefit.
- **Carry by identity.** R3 consumes M05's committed REAL study record when the *determining files* (registration
  `carry.journey_files`: `src/openflowsheet/**`, `benchmarks/m02/**`, `benchmarks/m04/**` (R2's verdict), `benchmarks/m05/**`,
  `requirements.lock`, the reactor environment lock) are byte-equal between M05's run commit and the journey commit J;
  otherwise it re-runs M05's study at J. The same rule carries the journey from J to the RC commit C (RC step 15).
- **Refusal is a result.** Without the reactor environment, R1 and R3 report `UNSUPPORTED(reactor_environment_unavailable)`
  and the journey exits 3 with the record written; R0 still runs. A missing M05 record with no way to re-run reports
  `UNSUPPORTED(m05_study_unavailable)`. Neither is ever rendered as a decision.

## 5. W25 — "end-to-end reactor refinement with honest evidence limits"

W25 is judged on the journey record at J and its carry or re-run at C. **PASS iff every clause holds.** A clause that
needs evidence outside both lanes' authority is `BLOCKED` (none is expected). Clause labels use the v0.2 grammar (§7.3).

| Clause | Holds iff | Assertions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W25 (a) Rungs | R0 and R1 each have nine grid records (verified, or the failure recorded); R2 records M04's verdict for the bound parent with its reasons verbatim and, if not `PROMOTABLE`, zero surrogate evaluations; R3 records M05's study record (sha256, carry or re-run) with its study and candidate statuses in M05's vocabulary | A20, A21, A15 |
| W25 (b) Before/after decisions | P01 and P13 each carry t_before, t_after, j_before, j_after, e_before, e_after, their FE class, and the class equals the reference function's on those numbers | A22 |
| W25 (c) Constraints | every decision (R0, R1, R3, the journey's) has the parent's certified state with M05 P3's inequalities evaluated (values and margins) and its bound activity; a bound-active decision carries the bound phrase | A23, A11 |
| W25 (d) Discrepancy | per grid point, J_R0 − J_R1 and its relative value; per grid point the reported quantities of §6.1; if R2 ran, surrogate − parent per grid point and band containment counts (not a coverage estimate) | A20, A15 |
| W25 (e) Uncertainty | e_k at every verified R1 point; the indifference set; R3's noise floor e* and, when M05 reports it, the indifference half-width; the discretization statement of §6.3 item 5 | A20, A21 |
| W25 (f) Truth checks | every decision is a parent evaluation (`targeted_check` or a grid point of R1); TC-1 present and equal to the reference function's | A23, A26 |
| W25 (g) Compute cost | per rung: cold experiments, store hits, wall s, against M07-budget-v1; any `BUDGET_EXHAUSTED` stated; the totals equal the store attributions | A25, A13 |
| W25 (h) Honest limits, reproducibility | the report has the twelve sections, §11 lists §6.3 verbatim, no forbidden word in generated prose, `check` and `replay` pass at C, `render` is byte-deterministic | A10, A11, A24, A61 |

**Not required for PASS:** that any FE class is `FE_CHANGED`; that R3 converges; that the decision is interior; that
the surrogate is promotable. **A FAIL** is a missing or wrong clause: a number the replay does not reproduce, an FE or
TC-1 label that disagrees with the reference function, a decision taken from R0 or R2, an unreported budget overrun, a
missing not-established list. `TC1_CONTRADICTED` is reported (the journey's decision falls back to the grid, §4.4.7),
travels as a limitation, and is a finding to the design lane about M05 — not a W25 FAIL.

## 6. The record and the report

### 6.1 Record `m07-journey-v1` (JSON, `benchmarks/m07/journey/<J>/journey.json`)

Top-level members (all required): `schema`, `registration_sha256`, `commit` (J), `environment` (lock sha256,
reactor environment lock sha256, platform, `tree_clean`), `case` (loop files' sha256), `rungs` {`R0`,`R1`,`R2`,`R3`},
`pairs` {`P01`,`P13`}, `tc1`, `decision` (§4.4.7), `accounting`, `limitations`, `artifacts` (store records by sha256),
`synthetic_dry_run` (true only for A10's fixture; such a record is never W25 evidence).
- **R0/R1 grid entry:** `T`, `T_literal`, `verified`, `outcome`, `certificate`, `J`, `e` (R1 only), `X_pass` (per-pass N₂
  conversion, reactor ξ / n_N₂,in), `Q_preheater_W`, `Q_flash_W`, `n_recycle_mol_s`, `n_purge_NH3_mol_s`,
  `extrapolated` (count, R-169), `experiments` {cold, store_hit}, `wall_s`, `run_sha256`. Variable names inside the
  state are the build lane's; these record names are fixed.
- **Rung summary:** `outcome` (§4.4.1 or `SURROGATE_NOT_PROMOTABLE`/`BUDGET_EXHAUSTED`/`UNSUPPORTED(<reason>)`),
  `decision`, `bound_activity`, `indifference_set` (R1), `budget` {cold, wall_s, spent}.
- **R2:** `m04_verdict`, `m04_reasons`, `m04_record` (path and sha256), `evaluations` (0 today).
- **R3:** `m05_record` (path, sha256, `carried_from` commit or `rerun`), `study_status`, `candidate` {T, status, J, e,
  half_width | null}.

### 6.2 Report `journey.md` (rendered from the record only)

Sections, in order (registration `report.sections`): 1 Summary; 2 Case and decision; 3 Rungs and their decisions;
4 The grid comparison; 5 Surrogate discrepancy; 6 Refinement; 7 Truth checks; 8 Uncertainty; 9 Compute cost;
10 Verification, validation and optimality, kept apart; 11 What this journey does not establish; 12 Provenance and
replay. Prose is template text from the registration plus numbers; **forbidden whole words** (case-insensitive) in
generated prose: optimal, optimum, validated, guarantee, guaranteed, proves. Quoted registered phrases are generated
prose too and contain none (GC-PHRASE-2).

### 6.3 Section 11, verbatim and in this order (registration `report.not_established`, 13 items)

The thirteen sentences in the registration (no empirical validation; not a plant design; no global optimality;
nothing outside 653.15–693.15 K; relative to the parent at num_z = 800, whose NH₃ output is estimated 1.0–1.4 % high
(M01 §10.5), an estimate not a bound; the simple rung is synthetic; extrapolated results counted not excluded; no
surrogate coverage claim; K_NH₃ enthalpy term rests on R-152; no reproduction on another architecture; no pressure-drop
or selectivity comparison; no equilibrium-reactor rung; no sensitivities of the decision). The **bound phrase**:
"The decision lies at the {side} bound of the reactor model's registered domain ({value} K, R-315). The objective may
improve beyond it; no model in this journey is registered there, and nothing is claimed about it."

### 6.4 Reproducibility

Reactor results are class R3 (reproduce from records; M02). `replay` re-derives every journey number from the stored
experiment records and the M05 record without calling the reactor, and must be **bitwise** equal to the record (the
inner solves are deterministic: G12's live re-run is bitwise). `render` twice gives identical bytes. `examples/` gets a
README pointer to the report; "an example is a demonstration, never gate evidence by itself" holds.

### 7.3 Clause labels W23–W27 (V11–V20, W21, W22: the alpha spec §5–§6, unchanged)

- **W23** (M04 spec §15 rows, in order): (a) conservation; (b) domain; (c) derivative; (d) default UQ; (e) insufficient
  data; (f) frozen splits and transforms; (g) promotion and rollback. Met on numerical verification as M04 §15 states;
  the real verdict `NOT_PROMOTABLE` is recorded, and a PROMOTABLE real verdict is not part of W23 (M04 N6).
- **W24**: (a) M03's fixed-topology NLP with final parent checks (nlp-tier A35–A42, audited environment); (b) TRF
  composition (M05 G2–G4, G13); (c) the eligible example TR-E2 with assumptions stated (G5); (d) FD truth accuracy and
  real-reactor accounting (G6, G7, G11); (e) parent checks and the refinement loop including the N6 branch (G8, G9);
  (f) constraints kept as constraints, limitations as stated limits (G7, G11, record content); (g) costs reported (the
  truth-ledger identities). (a) waits on `M03 N1` (rejudge_waits).
- **W25**: (a)–(h) of §5.
- **W26**: (a) M06 G1–G15 at C; (b) the browser test on CI x86-64.
- **W27** (M06 registration): (a) Tier 0 coverage re-taken at C_W against the candidate registry; (b) the seeded sample
  equals a re-draw from that coverage; (c) three canaries, disjoint from the sample, run before it; (d) the approved runs,

## 8. The release candidate C and the RC job

C is defined as the alpha's §8.1 with: version `0.2.0` (or `0.2.0bN`/`0.2.0rcN`); all six packages' manifests
`tested`; ADRs as §7.2; this spec's work orders done; `evidence/M07/<C>/manifest.json` `tested`; `CHANGELOG.md`
`## v0.2.0` with §10's phrases; nothing outward done.

| Step | What | Assertion |

## 9. W27 at M07

Order at the W27 candidate C_W (a commit with every v0.2 model row present, M04's surrogate row included): (1) the
WO-17 prerequisites (binder reading in `snapshot.READINGS`, the C1 id rows, the U14 rewrite; M06 registration §21.8,
§22.5 — the §20 ruling is already made in §21.6); (2) coverage re-taken at C_W; (3) the three canaries (up to three
re-canaries, Q3); (4) the seeded draw; (5) the 45 runs (Q5: even with 0 candidates). Spend stays within Frank's approval
(USD 15–45). **Carry to C:** the campaign stands at C iff `served_tool_list_sha256`, the `list_models` result and the
coverage rows are equal at C_W and C (registration `gate.w27_carry`); otherwise RC step 17 fails with "W27 campaign
surface differs between C_W and C" and a re-run is Frank's call (it costs money; §15 N7).

## 10. Release notes: `CHANGELOG.md` `## v0.2.0`, "What it is not"

Each of the eleven registered phrases (registration `gate.changelog_what_it_is_not`) appears verbatim: not a sandbox;
Linux only; reactor results reproduce from records (R3); the reactor domain (T_in 653.15–693.15 K, P 9–11 MPa,
H2/N2 2.5–3.5, inerts 0.035–0.2, per-tube flow 0.5–2 x nominal); no empirical validation of the C1 loop; no global
optimality; the optimization routes need the optional nlp extra; the stand-in reactor is synthetic; no external
benchmark score; no CFD or Peclet refinement; no equilibrium-stage subsystem.

## 12. Reference generator and executable self-claims

`m07_reference.py` writes `benchmarks/m07/registration.json` and refuses to emit when a self-claim fails:
GC-GRID-1…5 (grid), GC-LOOP-1…4 (twins and pins), GC-R0-1…3 (tolerance placement ≥ 10³ × floor and ≤ 10⁻⁸; guard and
N bound; regression tolerance), GC-RUNG-1…3, GC-IS-1 and -EXACT, GC-FE-1, -2 and -EXACT, GC-TC1-1, -2 and -EXACT,
GC-BOUND-1, -2, GC-G12-1…4 (F3 re-read from M02's records), GC-COST-1 (R1 budget ≥ 1.5 × measured worst case),
GC-BUDGET-1, GC-M04-1 (F1 re-read from M04's committed verdict), GC-VER-1…3 (Table T-V, 29 rows), GC-SET-1, GC-SET-2 (every re-judgement waits on a claimed gate and a Frank item),
GC-CLAUSE-1…4,
GC-RC-1, GC-PHRASE-1…4, GC-CAT-1, -2 (this table's ids equal the generator's catalogue). The rule functions in the
generator are the reference the build lane's tests compare against (A03–A07, A22, A23); they are independent of
`scripts/m07_journey.py`.

## 16. What this specification does not establish

- No validation: the journey is numerical verification of a workflow on a registered test configuration; nothing is
  compared with plant data. Self-generated journey numbers are records, not references.
- No optimality: neither the grid nor M05's study establishes a global or plant optimum; a bound-active decision
  says nothing about T outside the box.
- Not that fidelity changes the decision: the spec registers how the effect is measured, not what it will be.
- Nothing about an equilibrium reactor, pressure drop, selectivity, sensitivities of the decision, or another
  architecture. The dry-run record (A10) and the fixtures are synthetic and are never W25 evidence.
- No release decision: the gate decides whether a tag may be proposed; the tag is Frank's (ADR 0021 D5).
